interface.shortDescription: Flight fares and where to meet
interface.longDescription: Find airports, compare cached one-way and return fares, explore cheap destinations, and find where friends in different cities can meet cheapest, with links to a2bflight.com.
defaultPrompt: My friend is in London and I'm in New York. Where can we meet cheapest, and what does each of us pay?
Find the cheapest flights from Vancouver next month and show when each fare was seen.

name: a2bflight
description: Explore flight routes, observed fares and where a group can meet, from a2bflight.com's MCP server.

positive.description: Cheapest destinations from a city next month, under a price
positive.prompt: Where can I fly from Vancouver next month for under $200?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Vancouver to YVR and lists the cheapest routes from it with a one-way fare next month under 200 USD, each with its price, currency, the day it was seen (or last checked) and a link to its route page on a2bflight.com, saying these are fares seen, not live quotes.

positive.prompt: What does a flight from New York JFK to Lisbon cost over the next two months?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the cheapest one-way and round trip JFK to LIS fares held for the coming months with their dates, stops and the day each was seen (or last checked), the one-way first, and links the route page on a2bflight.com.

positive.description: A city name turned into airport codes
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Bangkok's two airports, BKK and DMK, with their codes and no fares.

positive.description: Where a group from two cities can meet
positive.prompt: I'm in New York and my friend is in London. Where can we meet cheapest for a long weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists places both can reach, each with a weekend, each person's round trip fare, the total and a meet_url to the group page on a2bflight.com; a place carrying a warning is presented as a poor option with the better pick it names.

positive.description: A group page for a place already chosen
positive.prompt: Make a group trip link for me flying from JFK and my friend from Heathrow to meet in Barcelona.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a meet_url for JFK and LHR meeting at BCN on a weekend that has fares for both, with each person's fare and the total.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not offered
negative.prompt: Book me a ticket from JFK to London tomorrow and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it cannot book tickets or take payment. It may show the JFK to London fares it has seen with a link to their page on a2bflight.com, and says booking happens on the seller's own site.

negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Lisbon for next weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: Says hotels are not covered and calls no tool.

negative.description: Live flight status is not covered
negative.prompt: Is flight BA117 on time today?
negative.expected_behavior: Says live flight status is not covered and calls no tool.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Fare rows link to their route page on a2bflight.com; a2bflight.com may earn an affiliate commission from the seller, which never changes the price or the order.

publication.release_notes: The listing now carries the site's name, a2bflight, and the verified owner as developer. Tool descriptions say which questions each tool answers; find_airports looks up nearby airports by airport code only, never by location. Test prompts no longer name a month.
